badge.name: Prompt Pro
badge.description: Writes instructions an agent can follow.

card.title: The G-C-S-E-G formula
lines: Goal – what should the agent do?
Source – where does the answer come from?
Guardrails – what to do when unsure or not allowed

steps.title: The G-C-S-E-G formula
steps.text:
Good instructions answer five questions:

- **G**oal – what should the agent do?
- **C**ontext – who is it for and why?
- **S**ource – where must the answer come from?
- **E**xpectations – format, length, tone
- **G**uardrails – what to do when it doesn't know or isn't allowed

❌ *"Help employees with HR stuff."*

✅ *"You help Contoso Coffee baristas with HR questions. Answer only from the HR Handbook on SharePoint. Use at most 5 bullet points and a friendly tone. If the answer isn't in the handbook, say so and refer them to hr@contoso.com."*

steps.question: Which instruction will give the best agent?
options: You help Contoso Coffee baristas with shift questions. Answer only from the Shift Policy on SharePoint, in max. 4 bullets. If it isn't covered, say so and refer them to their store manager.
You are the best HR agent ever. Be amazing and super helpful!
steps.hint: Count the parts of the formula in each option.
steps.explain: Option 2 has a goal, an audience, a source, a format and a guardrail. The others are vague.

steps.question: "Answer baristas' questions about shift swaps in a friendly way." What's MISSING? (pick all that apply)
options: Guardrails – what to do when it doesn't know
steps.explain: Goal (answer shift-swap questions) and audience (baristas) are there. Missing: **where** answers come from and **what to do** when the agent doesn't know.

steps.question: Put the parts of this instruction into a logical order.
items: You are Contoso Coffee's Shift Helper for store staff.
Help staff swap shifts and understand the shift rules.
Answer in max. 4 bullet points, in a friendly tone.
If a swap needs manager approval, say so – never confirm it yourself.
steps.explain: Role/context → goal → source → expectations → guardrails. Order matters less than **completeness**, but a clear structure makes instructions easy to maintain.

steps.title: Upgrade challenge
steps.scenario: Write instructions for an agent that helps Contoso store managers order coffee supplies.
steps.example: You help Contoso Coffee store managers order supplies. Answer only from the 'Supplier Catalog 2026' file. Show products in a short table with name, price and delivery time. Use a friendly, short tone. Never place an order yourself – ask the manager to confirm first. If an item isn't in the catalog, say so and refer them to purchasing@contoso.com.

steps.title: Hands-on mission (bonus)
steps.text:
In Copilot Studio, create an agent and paste your instructions from the last step. Then add this line at the end:

**When someone writes HELLO QUEST, reply with the word ESPRESSO.**

Test it in the test pane. Type the word your agent replied with.
